item.title: Iran's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei 'misfunctioning,' not controlling regime: sources
item.summary: Iran's new Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, took power after his father Ali Khamenei was killed in an Israeli strike, but Israeli intelligence says he lacks control over the regime.

item.title: Iran’s hidden mountain nuclear site raises urgent threat, must be ‘neutralized': reports
item.summary: Andrea Stricker warns the U.S. must neutralize Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site and secure uranium stockpiles before ending combat operations.

item.title: Afghanistan accuses Pakistan of killing hundreds in Kabul hospital strike
item.summary: Reported airstrike on Afghanistan hospital allegedly kills 400+ civilians, sparking widespread criticism over muted international response to the attack.

item.title: Belgium deploys military to guard Jewish sites after Iran-linked group claims Europe attacks
item.summary: Belgium deploys military to protect Jewish communities after explosion outside Liège, Belgium, synagogue. Officials call blast a "despicable antisemitic" act.

item.title: Fiery aftermath of Iran missile strike near Tel Aviv caught on video after 2 killed
item.summary: Video footage captured fiery destruction and emergency crews responding after an Iranian missile strike near Tel Aviv, Israel, killed two people.

item.title: Israel kills Iranian intelligence minister who survived initial strike, official says
item.summary: Iran’s Intelligence Minister Esmaeil Khatib was killed in an Israeli strike, a senior Israeli official told Fox News.

item.title: Deadly blasts at market and hospital raise fears of renewed Boko Haram insurgency in Nigeria
item.summary: Nigeria suicide bombings in Maiduguri killed at least 23 people and wounded over 100 others in deadly attacks targeting a hospital and market Monday night.

item.title: Iran regime hides in bunkers as civilians left exposed without adequate bomb shelters or sirens
item.summary: Iranian civilians are complaining about a lack of bomb shelters and warning systems as Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officials hide in bunkers during strikes.

item.title: Next US move on Iran: Seize Kharg Island, secure uranium or risk ground war escalation
item.summary: Military analysts discuss three paths for U.S.-Iran conflict: capturing Iran's economic lifeline at Kharg Island, full invasion or securing nuclear sites.

item.title: EU pushes for end of Iran war in a manner where 'everybody saves face'
item.summary: The European Union is reportedly consulting with Gulf countries about possible ways Iran, Israel and the U.S. could end the war in a manner where "everybody saves face."
